release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.4 fixes live paid preflop-range availability across the complete 174-scenario catalogue. The eligibility cache now invalidates when hand events, legal-turn state, dealing/busy state, player stacks, or all-in status changes. Exact duplicate source images are aliased only when their embedded pixel buffers are identical; differing same-history scenarios are disambiguated by current legal actions and all-in participants. The original 174 preflop charts, 1BB-per-hand review charge, CPU policy, and existing postflop controls are retained.
